title: excellent
text: great tour - nice guide and driver.  we talked about the vines out in the field, toured the cava-making facility and tasted 3 wines.
author: Ellen_B

title: Beautiful organic winery, excellent guide
text: We enjoyed a personal tour of an old family winery. Our guide was personable and added interest to the tour of the vineyard and winemaking facility with historical anecdotes. The Corpinnat wine sampling was excellent. A beautiful day.
author: Robert_R
